subject: general
question: According to the Economic Survey of India, which of the following states had the highest share in the overall production of groundnut for the financial year 2020-21?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gujarat state’s groundnut exports** surged to 4.7 lakh** metric tonnes (MT) in fiscal year.
 
• The maximum quantity of groundnut was exported to **Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines and China**. 
 
• Gujarat, the largest producer of the** oilseed in India**.
 
• **Gujarat**, it was sown in **20.65 lakh hectares** followed by** Andhra Pradesh 7.50 lakh ha, Rajasthan 7.28 lakh ha, Karnataka 5.34 lakh ha and Madhya Pradesh 2.80 lakh ha**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Peanut or groundnut (Arachis hypogaea), is a species in the legume or "**bean**" family.
 
• The peanut was probably first domesticated and cultivated in the valleys of **Paraguay**.
 
• Peanuts are known by many other local names such as **earthnuts, ground nuts, goober peas, monkey nuts, pygmy nuts **and** pig nuts**.
 
• The main Groundnut varieties produced in India are **Kadiri-2, Kadiri-3, BG-1, BG-2, Kuber , GAUG-1, GAUG-10, PG-1 , T-28, T-64, Chandra, Chitra, Kaushal, Parkash, Amber **etc.
 
• **Major Growing States:**
 
 
• Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Maharashtra ,Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Orissa, and Uttar Pradesh.
